 Assess traffic woes by yourself: Bhopal admn; schools declare holiday
 City | Ramendra.Singh | Nov 4, 2026, 00:08 IST Save Comments Share Bhopal: Schools across Bhopal district have been asked to assess their own traffic and commuting conditions and take suitable decisions on timings or operations for Nov 4, as a large public event and rally are expected to cause major congestion in several parts of the state capital. Meanwhile, schools issued holiday notices to students on Tuesday evening.
 The directive, issued by the District Education Officer, Bhopal, follows advisories from the office of the collector and district magistrate and the police commissioner, urban traffic police. The event is scheduled to begin at 10:00 AM in the Atal Path, T.T. Nagar area, with authorities anticipating 40,000–50,000 participants and thousands of vehicles.
 Police have planned diversions around T.T. Nagar, Roshanpura, Link Road No. 1 and 2, Bhadbhada, Jawahar Chowk, Polytechnic, Banganga, and adjoining routes. Officials have warned that the arrangements could severely affect the movement of school buses, private vehicles, and students during morning and afternoon hours.
 School heads have been directed to examine their location, the routes used by students, and the operation of school transport before deciding whether to alter timings, suspend classes, or modify bus operations for the day.
 Institutions have also been instructed to promptly inform parents, students, and vehicle operators of any decision taken, and to submit a compliance report to the district education office.
